summary: The user accepted and froze all six held-out geometries; a compatible SIGMA=0.20 eV six-sample VASP static-force-label batch was prepared locally and all diagnostic-static preflights passed, with no remote transfer or submission.

payload.objective: Establish whether the current AQCat25 checkpoint can be calibrated for the Fe(110) hydrogen-transfer TS/path domain before using it to accelerate the remaining C* + H* -> CH* transition-state search.
current_evidence: The user accepted all six rising/near-saddle/falling held-out structures and their exact structure and geometry hashes were frozen.
Six local VASP static-force-label input folders were prepared from configs/true_fe110_production.yaml stage transition_state.active_learning_force_label.
Every folder uses NSW=0, IBRION=-1, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV, ENCUT=400 eV, EDIFF=1e-6 eV, ISPIN=2, a 5x5x1 Gamma mesh, 32 cores, and the locked 45*2.2 1*0.0 1*0.0 MAGMOM pattern.
Repository diagnostic_static preflight passed for R1, R2, S1, S2, F1, and F2; every copied POSCAR still matches its frozen hash.
No remote transfer occurred and zero VASP/GPU jobs were submitted. POTCAR materialization and remote input checks remain execution-time work.
The batch remains force-label-only: reportable_final_energy=false and ts_domain_validated=false.
payload.one_executable_step: Review the prepared six-sample batch; only after explicit user batch-submission authorization may it be transferred to sunboquan-codex, bound to approved POTCAR and current diagnostic-static execution gates, and submitted.
payload.submission_boundary: Preparation does not authorize remote transfer, VASP submission, GPU prediction, fine-tuning, ML-NEB rerun, NEB, DIMER, frequency, connectivity, or barrier action.
done_when: At least five disjoint held-out VASP-labeled TS-domain structures pass registered bootstrap calibration metrics for the exact checkpoint and compatibility branch.
A hash-bound calibration review decides whether this checkpoint is reusable for the in-scope hydrogen-transfer path domain.
Only after calibration may the strategy engine choose the least-cost VASP NEB/CI-NEB/DIMER continuation from the complete path evidence.
